## Invitations

A total of 2365 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 93, representing a rate of 3.9 per cent. This level of attendance should be considered when planning future outreach activity and assessing the effectiveness of invitation arrangements. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, which may affect participation and should be taken into account when reviewing results.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The recorded SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the number of people receiving a reminder was 0. The absence of SMS invitations and reminders should be noted when considering opportunities to improve contact with invitees and support attendance.
